Address: 43.762456, 142.364512 (5-7 Alley Furari-to · Hachiya Gojo · 八谷五条)

Description: OPEN MAP: https://maps.google.com/?q=43.765234%2C142.362891. Late-night ramen; green-onion-heavy bowls. Walk-in. Confirm late hours before you go. No web seats. Station area.

Name: 05 Ramen Village
Address: 43.729845, 142.414567 (Asahikawa Ramen Village · 旭川ラーメン村 · Atsuta)
Description: OPEN MAP: https://maps.google.com/?q=43.729845%2C142.414567. Group sampler — multiple famous shops in one place. No group booking; pick a shop and queue. Taxi / car ~15 min from JR Asahikawa — not the station stroll.

Name: 06 Daikokuya

Name: 07 Taisetsu Ji-Beer Kan
Address: 1604-1 Miyashita-dori 11-chome, Asahikawa, Hokkaido 070-0030, Japan (北海道旭川市宮下通11丁目1604番地の1 蔵囲夢)
Description: OPEN MAP: https://maps.google.com/?q=43.765867%2C142.358119. Lamb + beer in the registered warehouse. Hot Pepper / official form. Closed Sun. 0166-25-0400. About 5–6 min from JR Asahikawa east. Not the Harete yatai-mura bar at 5-jo 9-chome.

Description: OPEN MAP: https://maps.google.com/?q=43.764725%2C142.362891. Lamb BBQ (Genghis Khan); friendly service; easier for first-timers. Recommended winter; walk-in queue peak summer. Hot Pepper Nov–May ski season. 0166-25-2550. Station area — not Daikokuya.

Description: OPEN MAP: https://maps.google.com/?q=43.728592%2C142.348011. Conveyor sushi for groups. Walk-in only — no seats booked. Official: ~10 min by car from JR Asahikawa. 0166-60-7711. Not a station-walk pin. Not Konishi.

Address: 3-jo-dori 6-chome Migi-6 Bldg A1F, Asahikawa, Hokkaido 070-0033, Japan (北海道旭川市3条通6丁目右6ビル A1F)
Description: OPEN MAP: https://maps.google.com/?q=43.765167%2C142.362398. Sit-down sushi dinner. Reserve. Official ~7 min from JR Asahikawa. 0166-22-4443. https://konishisushi.com/contact/ Not Triton.

Ticket-machine order. Taxi / car ~10 min from JR Asahikawa. Phone 0166-66-8120. Kaguraoka — not Midorigaoka. Not Okushiba.
